scope: Game-design questions and user answers only. Original options preserved when available. Dates in file names are America/Los_Angeles; provenance timestamps are UTC.
completeness: Recovered entries only; missing answers are explicitly marked. This is not a complete export of every chat or every historical interview.

entries.question: ❓ Q1 — How overpowered can a jackpot get? ➡️ I recommend shredding ordinary bots while bosses still demand a fight.
options: Shred ordinary bots; bosses remain dangerous (Recommended)
Allow rare rolls that melt bosses too
entries.answer: use 1 but with exceptions that later rounds still feel a bi hard like the progression in zombies games
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q2 — By “mid,” do you mean an average-quality roll should outperform an unupgraded Phasma in its intended role, while still allowing worse range, recoil or ammo economy? ➡️ I recommend keeping those tradeoffs.
options: Stronger in its role, with tradeoffs (Recommended)
Stronger than base Phasma in every major stat
entries.answer: Stronger in its role, with tradeoffs (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q3 — How bad can a bad roll be? ➡️ I recommend weaker or awkward but still functional, with occasional useful situations.
options: Weak or awkward, but usable (Recommended)
Some can be nearly useless before upgrading
entries.answer: Weak or awkward, but usable (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q4 — What determines an upgrade’s transformation? ➡️ I recommend giving each rolled gun its own fixed upgrade path, so its potential is real and upgrading develops that same gun.
options: Fixed path rolled with the gun (Recommended)
Player chooses between two paths
Roll a new random outcome on each upgrade
entries.answer: Fixed path rolled with the gun (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q5 — How should upgrade stages work? ➡️ I recommend one major transformation, with further upgrades only where that gun has a meaningful additional change.
options: Big transformation, then gun-specific follow-ups (Recommended)
Two major stages available to every gun
Keep three levels for every gun
entries.answer: Big transformation, then gun-specific follow-ups (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q6 — Should this redesign apply to Gale and Phasma too? ➡️ I recommend distinct upgrades for both, with wildcards having much more varied power and potential.
options: All guns; wildcards have the widest variation (Recommended)
Only wildcard guns for now
entries.answer: All guns; wildcards have the widest variation (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q7 — The free starting wildcard can currently use the full random pool. Should it still be able to roll a jackpot? ➡️ I recommend allowing it, with better jackpot odds on later shard rerolls.
options: Starting jackpots possible; later rerolls have better odds (Recommended)
Same full pool and odds from the start
Reserve overpowered rolls for later shard rerolls
entries.answer: Starting jackpots possible; later rerolls have better odds (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q8 — Which Pack-a-Punch qualities matter most? ➡️ I recommend both a dramatic weapon transformation and a short physical refit at our existing arsenal. You could use your other gun while it works.
options: Transformation plus a short physical refit (Recommended)
Weapon transformation, with instant arsenal upgrades
Focus mainly on the machine interaction
entries.answer: Transformation plus a short physical refit (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q9 — What should the potential symbol promise? ➡️ I recommend that it guarantees an exceptional upgraded form somewhere along that gun’s fixed path. The exact result can remain a surprise.
options: Guaranteed exceptional upgrade potential (Recommended)
Only a chance of an exceptional upgrade
entries.answer: Guaranteed exceptional upgrade potential (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q10 — How should later rerolls gain better odds? ➡️ I recommend improving the odds as the squad reaches deeper arenas, while keeping bad rolls possible. Repeatedly buying rolls alone would not improve the odds.
options: Improve with arena progress (Recommended)
Give every shard reroll the same improved odds
entries.answer: Improve with arena progress (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q11 — How long should the physical arsenal refit take? You can fight with your other gun during it. ➡️ I recommend about five seconds as our first test.
options: About 5 seconds (Recommended)
About 3 seconds
About 8 seconds
entries.answer: About 5 seconds (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q12 — How do you recover the upgraded gun? ➡️ I recommend collecting it from the arsenal yourself, with no timer that deletes an uncollected weapon.
options: Collect it yourself; no disappearance timer (Recommended)
Return it automatically when the refit finishes
entries.answer: Collect it yourself; no disappearance timer (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q13 — Can squad members upgrade at the same time? ➡️ I recommend independent refits so one player cannot block everyone else’s upgrade.
options: Each player can refit independently (Recommended)
One gun at a time for the whole squad
entries.answer: One gun at a time for the whole squad
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q14 — Should an upgrade also replenish ammunition? ➡️ I recommend a full magazine and that gun’s normal reserve allowance as part of a successful upgrade.
options: Refill magazine and normal reserves (Recommended)
Refill the magazine only
Keep the existing ammunition
entries.answer: refill ammo and half reserves
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q15 — How much should the arsenal reveal before spending shards? ➡️ I recommend showing the next upgrade’s exact stats and firing behavior, while leaving later transformations undiscovered.
options: Preview the next upgrade; hide later stages (Recommended)
Show only general hints before upgrading
Reveal the entire upgrade path immediately
entries.answer: Show only general hints before upgrading
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q16 — Must every overpowered gun have a major weakness? ➡️ I recommend that most have a tradeoff, but a very rare roll can be an excellent all-round weapon. Later-wave pressure still needs to matter.
options: Usually a tradeoff; rare all-round monsters allowed (Recommended)
Every overpowered gun needs a major weakness
Overpowered rolls can routinely excel at everything
entries.answer: Usually a tradeoff; rare all-round monsters allowed (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q17 — When should a player saving shards afford the first major upgrade? Currently, encounter clears pay 120 shards each, so the 450-shard upgrade becomes affordable after the fourth clear. ➡️ I recommend keeping that roughly 3–4-clear saving target; spending shards on rerolls would delay it.
options: After roughly 3–4 clears if saving (Recommended)
After roughly 1–2 clears
Near the end of the first arena
entries.answer: Near the end of the first arena
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q18 — Which weapon families should form the wildcard pool? ➡️ I recommend six: sidearms, compact automatics, rifles, precision rifles, scatterguns and heavy automatics. Compatible families can use conventional, coil, plasma or ion technology.
options: Use those six families (Recommended)
Use those six plus rare launchers
Start with a smaller selection
entries.answer: use 6 plus very rare launchers and unique melee weapons
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q19 — How mixed should the physical parts look? ➡️ I recommend coherent parts from each weapon origin, with rare compatible mixed-origin builds. Their shape and material should make the gun readable.
options: Coherent origins; rare compatible mixes (Recommended)
Freely mix parts from every origin
entries.answer: lets blend option 1 and 2. make it feel pretty all over the place with 100+ species from other galaxies they can look like anything
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q20 — Which special mechanisms belong in the first pool? ➡️ I recommend enemy-body penetration, controlled impact blasts, delayed secondary pulses, hit-earned ion discharges and sustained-fire power build-up. True surface ricochets and electrical chaining could widen the pool.
options: Use the five recommended mechanisms (Recommended)
Also include true ricochets and electrical chaining
Keep special mechanisms more limited
entries.answer: no lets use like 10 pls, get some inspo from halo and its different species and guns pls. and other guns with known very unique gun satyles
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q21 — Should bad rolls come from mechanical weaknesses? ➡️ I recommend recoil, spread, small capacity, slow reload/cycling, short effective range or slow handling. I would remove the current random self-damage, random damage wheel, health-steal and health/sprint/kill-streak damage multipliers.
options: Use mechanical weaknesses; remove those effects (Recommended)
Keep some of those existing effects—I'll specify
entries.answer: Use mechanical weaknesses; remove those effects (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q22 — How many special mechanisms can one gun combine? ➡️ I recommend one on most special guns, with two compatible mechanisms possible on a rare jackpot. Ordinary stat and part variations would still provide variety.
options: Usually one; rare jackpots can combine two (Recommended)
Always limit guns to one
Allow three or more on rare guns
entries.answer: Usually one; rare jackpots can combine two (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q23 — For your one-gun-at-a-time refit machine, does an uncollected finished gun block the next player? ➡️ I recommend moving finished guns to an owner-only collection tray so the machine can process the next gun. Players still return to collect their own weapon.
options: Finished gun moves to a collection tray (Recommended)
Machine stays occupied until the owner collects it
entries.answer: Machine stays occupied until the owner collects it
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q24 — For the ten signature mechanisms, I recommend: 1) shots that embed and detonate after enough hits; 2) switchable narrow/wide shot patterns; 3) real surface ricochets; 4) manually guided heavy projectiles; 5) short-lived damaging impact fields; 6) limited electrical chains; 7) continuous beams with heat management; 8) planted spikes you discharge later; 9) a held powered cutter; 10) broad shots that penetrate lined-up enemies. Keep this set, or which would you replace?
options: Keep these ten (Recommended)
Keep most; I’ll name replacements
Explore different mechanisms
entries.answer: keep 1, 2, 3, 4 (for heavy rare launcher types), 5, 7, 9, 10
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q25 — Which numbered concepts on the new image sheet do you like most, and which should we avoid? My strongest picks are 02 and 03, with 06 for rare melee; they give us very different construction styles.
entries.answer: 2,5,7 are ,my favorties.
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q26 — Should ranged wildcard guns always consume finite ammunition or cells, even if they also manage heat? I recommend this to preserve ammo pressure; an exceptional gun can still have excellent efficiency.
options: Finite ammunition/cells (Recommended)
Allow very rare heat-only guns
Vary freely by weapon
entries.answer: Finite ammunition/cells (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q27 — How should the rare melee weapons work? They would occupy one of the existing two weapon slots. I recommend dependable physical strikes plus stronger powered attacks that consume charge, so an empty battery still leaves a usable weapon.
options: Physical strikes + limited powered attacks (Recommended)
Unlimited powered attacks; balance reach and recovery
Every attack consumes charge
entries.answer: Physical strikes + limited powered attacks (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q28 — May unusual guns use one consistent alternate-fire button for switching patterns or triggering a planted charge? I recommend allowing it while keeping right-click for aiming. The exact key can be chosen after checking existing bindings.
options: Allow one shared alternate-fire input (Recommended)
Keep every mechanism on existing shoot/aim/reload controls
entries.answer: Allow one shared alternate-fire input (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q29 — For concept 02, which new finish should we try while keeping its grown-shell shape? I recommend dark iridescent ceramic with smoked glass.
options: Dark iridescent ceramic + smoked glass (Recommended)
Brushed silver + translucent blue
entries.answer: Dark iridescent ceramic + smoked glass (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q30 — How should the blue-magma gun fire? I recommend holding the trigger for a ragged spray of heavy, arcing splashes, with roughly six metres of useful reach. It would feel like throwing molten material rather than firing a straight beam.
options: Hold for a close-range splattering spray (Recommended)
Separate trigger pulls launch larger globs
entries.answer: use 1 but make the spray a bit unpredictable and random in the sense it blops a but to the left and right
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q31 — Does solar charging require the gun itself to be in direct sunlight, or is being anywhere in a sunlit arena enough? I recommend direct sunlight: roofs, deep shade and sunless arenas stop charging, while stored ammunition remains usable.
options: Direct sunlight required (Recommended)
Anywhere in an arena with sunlight
entries.answer: Direct sunlight required (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q32 — Can ordinary ammo drops refill the blue-magma gun? I recommend sunlight as its only normal refill source, making its indoor limitation meaningful. A paid weapon upgrade would still refill it under our existing upgrade rule.
options: Sunlight only; paid upgrades still refill it (Recommended)
Compatible ammo pickups can refill it too
entries.answer: Sunlight only; paid upgrades still refill it (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q33 — Who can the lingering blue magma hurt? It will damage enemies and its owner. I recommend protecting teammates from another player's magma so one player cannot repeatedly burn the squad.
options: Enemies and owner; teammates protected (Recommended)
Enemies and every player, including teammates
entries.answer: if its pack a punched it should deal very heavy damage and hurt teammates too
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q34 — Should this specific blue-magma weapon always be an exceptionally powerful, very rare wildcard result? I recommend a rare jackpot recipe with its short range, overheating and hazardous ground preserved.
options: Very rare jackpot recipe (Recommended)
Allow weaker versions of it in ordinary rolls
entries.answer: Very rare jackpot recipe (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q35 — For the wider parts pool, should functional parts determine real characteristics? I recommend rolling a body/frame, firing core, barrel/emitter, feed system, grip/bracing, cooling assembly and suitable optic. Compatible combinations set damage, cadence, accuracy, recoil, handling, capacity, reload, range and heat; finishes provide additional visual variety.
options: Functional parts shape performance (Recommended)
Mostly cosmetic parts; performance rolls separately
entries.answer: use 1 but add extended mag or normal as well pls, with a bit balance that makes it higher likelihood of getting an extended mag if the gun is rated really good and has a high or very low fire rate
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q36 — What optics belong in wildcard rolls? I recommend readable 1× sights for close-range guns, 1×–2× for general-purpose guns, and occasional 3×–4× for precision weapons, with sights fitted to each design.
options: Roll optics suited to the weapon's role (Recommended)
Use one consistent sight per weapon family
entries.answer: yes use 1, make a couple of each. i love the red dot with an upsidedown v style too
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q37 — Besides the special mechanisms, should normal wildcard firing cycles include semi-auto, full-auto, burst, pump/bolt, charged shots and heavy-weapon spin-up? I recommend all of these where the weapon family and physical design support them.
options: Include these compatible firing cycles (Recommended)
Keep semi-auto, full-auto and burst for now
entries.answer: Include these compatible firing cycles (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q38 — For the upgraded magma gun, should the owner and teammates take full enemy-level damage, or reduced but serious hazard damage? I recommend a brief touch hurting, while staying in the magma can down a player. Enemies would still take its full exceptional damage.
options: Reduced but dangerous damage to players (Recommended)
Full weapon damage to players too
entries.answer: Reduced but dangerous damage to players (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q39 — Must the magma gun be held to recharge in direct sunlight, or can it charge while stowed? I recommend held-only charging so replenishing it requires a deliberate choice.
options: Held in direct sunlight (Recommended)
Stowed or held while the player is in direct sunlight
entries.answer: Stowed or held while the player is in direct sunlight
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q40 — Should extended magazines usually bring a modest tradeoff? I recommend more capacity with a longer reload or slightly slower handling, while preserving the possibility of a rare excellent all-round roll.
options: Usually a modest tradeoff (Recommended)
Extra capacity without a built-in penalty
entries.answer: Usually a modest tradeoff (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q41 — What starting quality odds should we test? I recommend early rolls at 20% weak, 50% mid, 27% good and 3% jackpot; gradually reaching 10% weak, 40% mid, 42% good and 8% jackpot in deep arenas. Mid rolls still beat base Phasma within their intended role.
options: Use that mix as initial tuning (Recommended)
Make jackpots rarer
Make strong rolls more common
entries.answer: Use that mix as initial tuning (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q42 — For the very rare weapons, I recommend roughly 1% launcher rolls and 1% dedicated melee rolls. The blue-magma recipe would appear in about 0.25% of early rolls, rising to 0.5% later, counted inside the jackpot odds. Should we start there?
options: Use those initial rare-weapon odds (Recommended)
Make these weapons more common
Make these weapons rarer
entries.answer: Use those initial rare-weapon odds (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q43 — How often should a weak roll have the symbol guaranteeing an exceptional upgrade path? I recommend about one in five weak rolls. Other quality levels can also have exceptional paths, but an ordinary weak roll would still improve without always becoming a monster.
options: About one in five weak rolls (Recommended)
About one in ten weak rolls
About one in three weak rolls
entries.answer: make it feel a bit random, it has a 80% chance of happening between 3-8 rolls and for sure under 10 rolls
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q44 — When upgrading, should “full magazine and half reserves” mean topping reserves up to at least 50%, or adding another half-reserve to what you already have? I recommend topping up to at least 50%, preserving any ammunition already above that amount.
options: Top up to at least half; preserve surplus (Recommended)
Add half a reserve to existing ammo, up to capacity
entries.answer: Top up to at least half; preserve surplus (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q45 — I recommend testing 700 shards for the first major transformation: saving the first arena's six 120-shard rewards gives 720. Meaningful later stages would initially cost 1,200 and 1,800 where that gun has them. Does that fit your upgrade pacing?
options: Use these initial upgrade prices (Recommended)
Make upgrades cheaper
Make upgrades more expensive
entries.answer: Use these initial upgrade prices (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q46 — For “80% between rolls 3–8, guaranteed under 10,” how should the remaining 20% work? I recommend 10% on rolls 1–2, 80% on rolls 3–8, and 10% on roll 9. That allows occasional early surprises and never reaches roll 10.
options: 10% on 1–2; 80% on 3–8; 10% on 9 (Recommended)
80% on 3–8; remaining 20% on 9
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q47 — What does that guarantee produce? I recommend a gun with the symbol guaranteeing an exceptional upgraded form, regardless of its current quality. Immediate jackpot odds would still follow the separate arena-progression curve.
options: Potential-marked gun, any current quality (Recommended)
Specifically a weak gun with exceptional potential
An already-powerful jackpot gun
entries.answer: Potential-marked gun, any current quality (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q48 — Who owns the counter? I recommend a separate counter for each player, kept across arenas and Continue, starting fresh with a new run.
options: Each player, for that run (Recommended)
One shared counter for the squad
entries.answer: Each player, for that run (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q49 — What counts as a roll? I recommend every new wildcard offer: the free starter offer plus token-funded or shard-funded rerolls. Looking at the same gun again and buying known weapons would not count.
options: Every new wildcard offer (Recommended)
Only wildcard weapons actually kept
Only weak wildcard offers
entries.answer: Every new wildcard offer (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q50 — When does the counter restart? I recommend when a potential-marked offer appears, even if you pass on it. That makes taking or rejecting that gun a meaningful decision.
options: When the marked offer appears (Recommended)
Only when the marked gun is kept
entries.answer: When the marked offer appears (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: ❓ Q51 — Your timing bands both include roll 8. Which interpretation should we use? I recommend 5% on rolls 1–3, 80% on 4–8, and 15% on 9–10. We can also keep your literal 8–10 final band, which gives roll 8 extra weight. Both follow your newer maximum of 10 rolls.
options: Final 15% covers 9–10 (Recommended)
Keep 8–10; give roll 8 extra weight
entries.answer: Final 15% covers 9–10 (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.

entries.question: Final design confirmation — Approve implementation of the complete IRON SUN wildcard specification: the eight selected mechanisms; varied alien functional parts, normal/extended magazines and multiple optics; fixed gun-specific upgrade paths; the per-player potential-symbol counter (5% on rolls 1–3, 80% on 4–8, 15% on 9–10); shared five-second refits with owner collection; the solar blue-magma jackpot; and inventory, co-op and save integration. Use the agreed initial roll odds and 700/1,200/1,800-shard upgrade prices, then validate the results.
options: Approve—implement the complete plan (Recommended)
Revise the plan before implementation
entries.answer: Approve—implement the complete plan (Recommended)
entries.interpretation: Historical answer; current rules and later corrections are in ../../current.json.
